name: CMF Phone 1

name: FP4
notes: Notably thick, uniform bezels on all sides (repairable/modular design priority); boxy, minimal corner radius.

name: FP5
notes: Softer, more rounded corners than FP4 but bezels remain characteristically thick and uniform.

name: FP6
notes: Continues thick-bezel repairable design language, marginally slimmer body than FP5; dimensions estimated from memory, not independently verified this session.

name: Pixel 6
notes: Flat front glass (no curved edges, unlike 6 Pro); two-tone camera bar is a back-only detail.

name: Pixel 6 Pro
notes: Curved-edge display glass wraps the side rails, most distinctive silhouette trait of this generation.

name: Pixel 6a
notes: Flat sides, no curved glass; chin visibly thicker than top/sides. Side fingerprint built into power button.

name: Pixel 7
notes: Flat sides, uniform thin bezels; camera bar color-matched to frame (back-only detail).

name: Pixel 7 Pro
notes: Last generation with pronounced curved-glass side profile before Google flattened the design in the 8 series.

name: Pixel 7a
notes: Chin bezel considerably thicker than the rest, most visibly budget of the a-series covered here.

name: Pixel 8
notes: Google roughly doubled the front corner radius vs Pixel 7, first generation with the pronounced 'squircle' corners.

name: Pixel 8 Pro
notes: Flattened the curved-glass sides entirely while going rounder in the corners vs 7 Pro; a real design inflection point.

name: Pixel Fold
notes: Inner-screen selfie camera sits in a bezel strip above the display rather than a punch-hole cutout; unfolded shape is nearly square/slightly wide, very distinct vs bar phones.

name: Pixel 8a
notes: 8-series rounded-corner shape combined with a-series' thicker chin.

name: Pixel 9
notes: Flat non-curved front glass, boxier silhouette than Pixel 8, even bezels on all sides.

name: Pixel 9 Pro
notes: Identical footprint to base Pixel 9, first year Pro and base share the same body size.

name: Pixel 9 Pro Fold
notes: Google narrowed/lengthened the cover screen vs the 2023 Pixel Fold so folded aspect ratio looks like an ordinary phone; inner camera moved to an actual hole-punch cutout instead of a bezel strip.

name: Pixel 9 Pro XL
notes: Same design as 9 Pro, taller/wider body for the 6.8" screen.

name: Pixel 10
notes: Same footprint and front design as Pixel 9; third rear camera is a back-only change.

name: Pixel 10 Pro
notes: Front design essentially unchanged from Pixel 9 Pro.

name: Pixel 10 Pro Fold
notes: Same normal-phone folded aspect ratio as 9 Pro Fold, thinner even bezels.

name: Pixel 10 Pro XL
notes: Same design as 10 Pro, taller/wider body.

name: Pixel 9a
notes: Bottom bezel only marginally thicker than top/sides (evened out vs 8a's uneven chin), plastic back.

name: Pixel 10a
notes: Own a-series-only color palette this gen; thick but symmetric bezels, plastic back.

name: Pixel 11
notes: Front design essentially unchanged from Pixel 10; main differentiator is a rear LED ring (back-only).

name: Pixel 11 Pro
notes: New glossy color-matched frames (Dune/Pine) vs prior matte two-tone frames; front layout otherwise unchanged.

name: Pixel 11 Pro Fold
notes: Normal-phone folded aspect ratio, consistent with 9/10 Pro Fold generation.

name: Pixel 11 Pro XL
notes: Same design as 11 Pro, taller/wider body.
